text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought Almond Eye to the infirmary after she suffered a minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal.
There's barely any pain at all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Once first aid is done,
shall we get back to training?
choice_data_list: No, let's just wrap it up for today.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...I'm happy you're worried about me,
but it really isn't a big deal, you know?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Here, look into my eyes.
Do I look like I'm lying to you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: Hmm, I can't see it, though...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
See, right?
It's fine, so let's continue training, okay?
choice_data_list: I want you to rest now so you can keep winning in the future.
I'll adjust the menu a little, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of winning...
Then that's all the more reason—
choice_data_list: Look me in the eyes, Ai

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I trust your judgment.
Admittedly, I wasn't being very level-headed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's win the race and prove
that today's decision wasn't a mistake!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I got it!
Well then, right away—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
It hurts a bit more than it did earlier...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, we called training off early to keep it from getting any worse.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, looks like this much should be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Trainer!
...All right, let's keep it up just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, training continued
within a reasonable range.
